meta.title: Our Companies — PubliX Group Portfolio
meta.description: The six founder-led SaaS companies in the PubliX Group portfolio, building essential software for Nordic public services.
meta.og_image_alt: PubliX Group — Nordic public-sector SaaS growth platform

hero.title: Founder-led, mission‑driven
hero.sub: Every company in the PubliX portfolio was built by founders who care deeply about public services. They chose to join us and stayed to keep building.

companies.name: Tidvis
companies.desc: Tidvis provides an integrated business system for the social care sector: scheduling, time reporting, payroll and documentation in one platform for personal assistance and LSS providers. Their tools are designed by people who understand the daily reality of care work.

companies.name: digiPlant
companies.desc: digiPlant develops SBS Manager, an application management platform for foundations, sponsors and public organisations, from receiving applications to review, decision and disbursement. Easier applications, shorter handling times and more grants paid out.

companies.name: Aspicore
companies.desc: Aspicore builds digital platforms for foundation and grant management, helping public-benefit organisations process applications, manage grants and ensure transparent governance.

companies.name: Koivu Solutions (Sotender)
companies.desc: Koivu Solutions develops Sotender, a mobile-first platform that connects healthcare workers with open shifts and reduces reliance on staffing agencies. The wellbeing services county of Ostrobothnia has reported annual savings of more than EUR 7 million.

companies.name: Embrace Safety
companies.desc: Embrace Safety develops EMBRACE, a platform for knowledge-based crime prevention and safety promotion. Municipalities, police authorities and organisations use it to map situation reports, analyse causes and follow up preventive measures.

companies.name: Bleau
companies.desc: Bleau develops moliri, a compliance-driven platform for secure and accessible digital communication in the public sector, and NemBolig for Danish social housing organisations. Content is checked for accessibility, security and compliance at the point of publishing.

quote.text: "Right from our first contact, we felt a strong trust in the buyer. They treated us with respect, asked thoughtful, sensible questions and really listened to our answers. We also felt that PubliX offered a structure — a group of companies that all contribute to societal value."

timeline.title: What happens after you join
timeline.sub: Joining PubliX is designed to be straightforward. This is what the first year looks like for a typical portfolio company.
timeline.t1_desc: Your team, your office, your customers. We're not here to reorganise.
timeline.t2_desc: We work together on economics, pricing, compliance and security.
timeline.t3_desc: Cross-sell to shared customers, open new countries, add adjacent workflows.
timeline.t4_desc: Share in the collective growth of the group. Your success compounds.
